title: Part Sale totals add up the saved line prices
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts', 'See Financial Data', 'Customers — View', 'Customers — Create & Edit' and 'Part Sales — Create & Edit'.
  • Have a new category for this test, category A, priced by a new matrix for this test, matrix A, with one cost range ($0.00 and up) whose Default rule is Markup % 35.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses, whose column in matrix A is Markup % 20.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, put on tier A for Part Sales in Edit Customer.
  • Have a new Part Sale for this test, Part Sale 1, for customer A, made after customer A's tiers were set.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Open Part Sale 1.
  2. Add a part with category A and cost 100.00 to Part Sale 1.
  3. Click the Statistics tab.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Part Sale 1 opens.

Step 2:

  • The part reads $120.00 ($100.00 × 1.20).

Step 3:

  • Statistics show parts of $120.00 and cost $100.00, the saved line price and cost ($120.00 − $100.00 = $20.00 profit).
